name: Yoink
description:
Copy on select with a modifier key, clipboard history and terminal shortcuts that work on any keyboard layout.

• Hold Shift while selecting text and it goes to the clipboard, ready for Ctrl+V. Works in terminals too, even inside apps that capture the mouse, like Claude Code, Codex, vim or tmux. Pick any modifier combination, or none to copy every selection.
• Clipboard history in the top panel or on Super+Shift+V. Passwords from KeePassXC are skipped.
• Ptyxis Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+Shift+V and other shortcuts on Cyrillic, Greek and other non-Latin layouts.
